overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether a leading '*' is passed (list as object-name string vs. list reference number). R5 removes the old second-line command-name footnote marker without changing the merged optional-star signature. enterable, styles, icon and color are outputs ('←' in the docs); itemRef supports the documented 0/'*' sentinels.

params.description: If present, 'list' below is an object name (string); if omitted, 'list' is a hierarchical list reference number.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the list
the current item of the list

params.name: icon
params.description: Picture assigned to the item: a 'path:' pathname if set via a picture file, or (depending on the variable's type) the number or 'pictlib:' name if set via a library picture; blank if no icon is associated.

params.name: color
params.description: RGB color of the item's text.
